st.goal: Get control back. Start with a no-pressure tracking week.
st.why: Being fully present with the people I love. Clear mornings and steady energy. Becoming someone I am proud of.
st.rule: I log slips instead of hiding them. A slip is data, not a reset.
st.ask: If I tell you I slipped, just say "thanks for telling me." No advice, no fixing.

plan.when: I'm in bed late at night
plan.then: Get up and leave the room for 10 minutes. Water, stretch, tidy something. Then back to bed without my phone.
Text or call one person. A message counts. Or go somewhere with people around.
10-minute walk outside, or 10 minutes on a hobby or project.
Move my body (walk, pushups), then write one sentence about what's stressing me.

slipPlan: Log it in 30 seconds. No hiding.
One small action within the hour: water, step outside, or text someone.
No big decisions tonight, and no "I blew it" verdicts.
Tomorrow: check in as usual. Nothing resets. Ask what the trigger was and what to change.
If I want to, tell my safe person: "I slipped."
reasons: Being fully present with the people I love
Becoming someone I am proud of
menu: Write three lines in a notebook
Read five pages of a book
Work on a hobby for ten minutes
wind: Phone goes on its charger outside the bedroom
Set tomorrow's alarm (a real alarm clock if I have one)
Lay out tomorrow: clothes, water, keys
Read, stretch, or write a few lines instead of scrolling
